title: SVEP1 enables ANG2 binding to TIE1 and receptor signaling, guided by AlphaFold-Multimer
summary: AlphaFold-Multimer structure predictions of SVEP1 complexes helped identify the CCP20 domain of human SVEP1 as the primary TIE1 binding site. SVEP1 mediated strong ANG2 binding to TIE1, and combined SVEP1 and ANG2 stimulation of lymphatic endothelial cells phosphorylated TIE1 and increased FOXO1 nuclear exclusion and AKT phosphorylation. Structure prediction was one guide among many binding and signaling experiments.
